fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura/hemolytic uremic syndrome (TTP/HUS): Has occurred in patients with advanced HIV-1 disease and in allogenic bone marrow transplant and renal transplant patients receiving 8 grams per day of valacyclovir hydrochloride in clinical trials. summary: A small computer model, not tests on people, calculated a high risk score of 77 for the liver and a low risk score of 31 for the heart [M]. Official warnings state that serious blood and kidney disorders, known as TTP and HUS, have occurred in specific high-risk clinical trial patients taking 8 grams of valacyclovir hydrochloride per day [3]. Additionally, one clinical study involving valacyclovir was stopped early because participants experienced serious treatment-related health issues [5].
